subject: Renewal kickoff: staged commitment & capacity runway
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@cloudhaven.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: staged commitment & capacity runway

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — it was great to hear about Cloudhaven's expansion plans for the payments team. We're putting together a concise renewal path that reduces short-term lift for your procurement team while giving you the headroom you need for spike weeks.

High-level proposal (attachments):
- Staged commitment: a 12-month staircase that increases commit at quarter boundaries (see proposed-staircase-commitment.pdf)
- Capacity runway: 2x burst pool for peak weeks + rolling buffer (see capacity-forecast-2026Q3.xlsx)
- Mutual action plan (MAP) draft for signoff (MAP-Cloudhaven-v1.docx)

Ask: can we lock a 60-minute QBR-style kickoff with execs and procurement next week to review the MAP and term changes? Suggested windows: Tue 6/1 10–11am PT or Wed 6/2 3–4pm PT. If those don't work, send a couple of windows and we'll adapt.

Next steps from our side:
1) Share the MAP + forecast (attached) — please flag anything that needs to be escalated to legal/procurement.
2) We can scope an amendment (term swap + staircase) for legal review after the QBR.
3) Confirm target effective date for the new commit (we suggested 2026-07-01 in the MAP).

I'll leave marissa and rafael on copy to coordinate the calendar and prep materials.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-staircase-commitment.pdf (proposal), capacity-forecast-2026Q3.xlsx (forecast), MAP-Cloudhaven-v1.docx (draft MAP)
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@cloudhaven.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amir Hassan <amir.hassan@cloudhaven.io>
Date: 2026-05-28T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: staged commitment & capacity runway

Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I'm reviewing the MAP and the forecast with Amir (CFO) and our procurement lead. A couple quick items:

- We like the staircase idea, but procurement has questions about mid-term exit provisions and pro-rated billing for the ramps.
- Can you clarify how the burst pool billing is handled when we cross the threshold?
- Legal will need the amendment template before the QBR so they can start redlines.

Tue 6/1 10am PT works for our core team; could you invite procurement and legal (procurement@cloudhaven.io will be on the call)?

Also, can you send a 1‑page executive summary for Amir before the meeting?

Best,
Priya Reddy
Head of Platform Operations
Cloudhaven
